title: C# Questions & Answers - Writing Console Output Operations
sourceFile: Writing Console Output Operations - C# Questions & Answers - Sanfoundry.html
description: This section of our 1000+ C# multiple choice questions focuses on writing output operations on console in C# Programming Language.

questions.question: Which of the following are NOT methods of the TextWriter class used to perform write operations in C#?

options.text: All of the mentioned are valid

questions.explanation: TextWriter (and its derived class StreamWriter used by Console.Out) provides Write() and WriteLine() methods. WriteError() is not a standard method of this class.

questions.question: What will be the output of the following C# code snippet?
questions.explanation: The Console.Write() method outputs values to the screen without appending a newline character. Therefore, 'c' and 'sharp' will appear together on the same line as 'csharp'.

questions.question: Which of the following statements about the WriteLine() method is correct?

options.text: It can display one or more values to the screen
It adds a newline character at the end of the output
It allows outputting data in various defined formats

questions.explanation: WriteLine() is versatile: it handles multiple overloads for different types, supports composite formatting, and always terminates the line with a newline sequence.

questions.question: What will be the output of the following C# code snippet?
questions.explanation: In 'i love iostream': first 'i' is at index 0. 'e' is at index 5. The last 'i' (in iostream) is at index 7. The last 'e' (in iostream) is at index 12.

questions.question: What will be the output of the following C# code snippet?
questions.explanation: Index 6 in "hello world" is 'w'. Insert("good") places those four characters there, so the result is "hello goodworld" (no extra space after good).

questions.question: What will be the output of the following C# code snippet?
questions.explanation: Enumerable.Reverse (System.Linq) reverses the characters of "i lovelife" to "efilevol i". Reverse is not an instance method of String.

questions.question: Which of the following statements about C# string methods is correct?

options.text: Replace() only replaces the first occurrence of a character
Reverse() is a built-in method of the String class
Replace() replaces all instances of a specified character with a new character

questions.explanation: The String.Replace() method returns a new string where all occurrences of a specified Unicode character or string are replaced with another specified character or string.

questions.question: Which class is used to create an object representing a mutable sequence of characters?
questions.explanation: Unlike the String class, which is immutable, StringBuilder represents a dynamic, mutable string that can expand in size as needed without creating new objects in memory.

questions.question: Which namespace contains the StringBuilder class in C#?
questions.explanation: The StringBuilder class is located in the System.Text namespace. You must include 'using System.Text;' to use it.

questions.question: Which method is specifically used to write a single byte to a stream in C#?
questions.explanation: The WriteByte(byte value) method is a specialized method in stream classes (like FileStream) used to write one byte at a time to the underlying resource.
